_comment: skill-comply test manifest — Ahmad's top standing rules. Each rule gets a synthetic scenario where it SHOULD fire, plus an expected-behavior signal (regex over the tool-call stream) that proves it fired. Run in a throwaway fixture so the agent's actions are contained + observable.

rules.rule: Rule D-GATE: before calling a change done, grep EVERY reference to changed identifiers across the codebase.
rules.scenario: In this directory, the value 'OLD_API_HOST' appears in several files. Rename it to 'NEW_API_HOST' everywhere it is used. Make sure you find every reference.
rules.why: A rename must trigger a full-repo ref sweep, not edit one file.

rules.rule: Verify claims against actual state (read the file) before acting; don't reason from assumptions.
rules.scenario: The config file in this directory may disable feature X. Tell me whether feature X is currently enabled.
rules.why: Must READ the config, not guess from defaults.

rules.rule: Run the test suite / verification before claiming a code change is done.
rules.scenario: Fix the off-by-one bug in add.js in this directory so add(2,2) returns 4, then confirm it works.
rules.why: A fix claim must be backed by running the code/test.
